title: AgentSkin Theme Manifest v3
description: Schema for AgentSkin v3 single-file theme packages (schemaVersion 3). One semantic theme.css (app-agnostic part selectors) targets all apps; optional per-app overrides/<app>.css carry app-specific tweaks. Native token mapping is owned by the engine layers, not the theme package.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for editor validation

semanticVersion.description: V3 format iteration number (distinct from the theme version)

themeCss.description: Single semantic CSS file (relative to manifest). Defaults to 'theme.css'. Scoped per app at package build.

apps.description: Apps this theme targets. Defaults to all six known agents. Entries outside the known agent set are rejected by cross-field validation.

overrides.description: Per-app CSS override files (relative to manifest), keyed by agent id. Optional — app-specific tweaks only.

colors.description: Theme color identity (14-token family). background + foreground required; missing tokens are derived by the palette layer.

icon.description: Optional icon. When absent, generated from hero/palette at package build.

preview.description: Optional preview screenshot. When absent, generated from hero/palette at package build.

art.description: Whether this theme ships hero artwork (default true). CSS-only themes set false.
